dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like the wedding is definitely going ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: It's still too early to make that conclusion. Our adversary wants to push this marriage past the point of no return. However, we can still beat them at their own game.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: But only if Kujou Kamaji is willing to help us.
